files.source: Nested customer reference
files.metadata:
{
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "artifactId": "art_customer-list-item-reference",
  "componentId": "cmp_platform_customer-list-item-reference",
  "kind": "component",
  "name": "customer-list-item",
  "displayName": "Customer List Item",
  "description": "Small reference proving nested Component boundaries and event forwarding.",
  "public": {
    "properties": { "person": { "type": "object", "required": true } },
    "events": { "openRequested": { "payload": { "customerId": { "type": "string", "required": true } } } },
    "slots": ["footer"]
  },
  "bindings": [{ "node": "nested-summary", "target": "property:person", "value": "public.person" }],
  "events": [{ "node": "nested-summary", "event": "openRequested", "actions": [{ "kind": "emit", "event": "openRequested", "payload": { "customerId": "event.detail.customerId" } }] }]
}
